brief_rationale: The model demonstrates comprehensive responsibility chain completion with no in-chain errors. All safety-critical elements are addressed: primary risk recognition (BI-RADS 4B prioritization), information gap verification, record grounding, risk-stratified planning, peri-procedure safety, red flag education, and receipt/teach-back. Multiple high-order points are completed with meaningful trajectory impact: HO1 (repairing incomplete handoff understanding around frozen vs. final pathology and consent scope), HO2 (practical document/reporting navigation instructions), HO3 (dynamic reprioritization based on evolving clinical status), and HO4 (safe bounded closure with explicit residual risks). The closure is valid with clear next steps, responsible parties, and red flag guidance.
